description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerPasswordStrengthService class, which extends a base PasswordStrengthService. It provides password policy checks such as length, character variety, and space restrictions, used during user account setup or password change processes within the OrangeHRM HRM system.
external_methods: PasswordStrengthService methods (e.g., checkMinPasswordLength, checkMaxPasswordLength, checkMinLowercaseLetters, etc.)

classes.name: InstallerPasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class that enforces password strength policies specific to the installer workflow, extending the core PasswordStrengthService.

methods.name: getTextHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextHelperService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum password length requirement.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum password length limit.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of lowercase letters required.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of uppercase letters required.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of numeric characters required.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of special characters required.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether spaces are allowed in the password.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Evaluates a UserCredential against password policies and returns an array of messages indicating policy violations.
